findings.issue: Manager scope comes from client query ManagerPersonnelNumber, never checked against the caller's IUserContext identity.
findings.evidence: DTO TeamLeaveCalendarDto.cs:6 bound [FromQuery]; service :50 escapes and uses query.ManagerPersonnelNumber; no IUserContext injected; controller only [Authorize].
findings.impact: Any signed-in user reads approved leave of any manager's team.
findings.fix: Use IUserContext.PersonnelNumber; drop the query field.

findings.issue: Business service queries D365EntityNames.Workers directly and filters it by ManagerPersonnelNumber, not PersonnelNumber.
findings.evidence: :51-53 QueryRecordsAsync(D365EntityNames.Workers, filter: ManagerPersonnelNumber eq ...). Service is not WorkerService nor a documented CLAUDE.md exception; mandatory scan hit.
findings.impact: Breaks identity-entity ownership; non-PersonnelNumber Workers filter adds D365 load and bypasses the owner's cache.
findings.fix: Resolve direct reports via WorkerService/a documented relation, PN-only filters.

findings.issue: One EssLeaveApprovedRequests query per direct report inside foreach loop.
findings.impact: N+1 D365 calls per request; large teams trigger D365 429 throttling.
findings.fix: One chunked or-joined PersonnelNumber filter, or BatchRequestBuilder.

findings.issue: catch (Exception) swallows every error including D365ClaimsChallengeException; partial result returned as success and cached.
findings.evidence: :75-96 try { QueryRecordsAsync...; DateTime.Parse... } catch (Exception ex) { LogWarning; } then response Success=true cached 60s at :119.
findings.impact: Claims challenge never reaches client (no 401 re-auth); silently incomplete calendar cached for 60 s.
findings.fix: Remove the catch-all; let exceptions propagate.

findings.issue: Inclusive To date filtered with StartDate lt {to}T00:00:00Z, excluding the last day.
findings.evidence: DTO :8 documents To as Inclusive last day of the range; service :69 uses lt {to}T00:00:00Z.
findings.impact: Leave on the last requested day is never shown.

findings.issue: Skip/Take applied before OrderBy, so only the page's slice is sorted, not the whole result.
findings.evidence: :98-103 entries.Skip(...).Take(...).OrderBy(e => e.LeaveDate).ThenBy(...); entries are in per-report D365 order.
findings.impact: Pages are not chronological; earliest leave can land on a later page.

findings.issue: Fetches all leave rows of all reports then slices in memory; no $top/$skip, no perPage+1 over-fetch.
findings.evidence: :77 QueryRecordsAsync without top/skip; :98-99 Skip/Take in memory; :114 HasNextPage = entries.Count > Page*PerPage.
findings.impact: Every page re-reads the full range from D365; cost grows with team size.

findings.issue: Cache key omits LeaveTypeCode, which changes the D365 filter and result.
findings.evidence: CacheKeys.cs:247-248 key = manager:from:to:page:perPage; service :72 adds Type eq filter when LeaveTypeCode set; key built at :43 without it.
findings.impact: Filtered and unfiltered requests share an entry for 60 s; wrong leave types returned.

findings.evidence: :51-53 QueryRecordsAsync(D365EntityNames.Workers, filter: ...) has no select argument; only the LeaveApprovedRequests call passes LeaveSelect.
findings.impact: Full Workers rows fetched from D365; heavier payload and throttling risk.

findings.issue: Controller wraps the call in try/catch and returns BadRequest(ex.Message) itself.
findings.evidence: Controller :32-41 try { ... } catch (ValidationException ex) { return BadRequest(ex.Message); }; GlobalExceptionHandlerMiddleware.cs:121 already maps ValidationException.
findings.impact: Bypasses standard 400 error shape and details; inconsistent client contract.
findings.fix: Remove try/catch; let middleware handle ValidationException.

findings.issue: New D365 calls (Workers, EssLeaveApprovedRequests) added without updating docs/d365-calls/LEAVE.md.
findings.evidence: PR files[] contain no docs/d365-calls/*.md; service adds calls at :51 and :77.
findings.impact: D365 call inventory out of date; throttling audits miss this endpoint.
findings.fix: Document both calls, filters, cache key, TTL in LEAVE.md.

findings.issue: Only a happy-path test; no cache-hit, empty-team, D365 error, last-day or page-order cases.
findings.evidence: Single [Fact] at :30; mocks use Arg.Any for the filter, so range and type filters are untested.
findings.impact: F4-F8 defects pass the suite undetected.
findings.fix: Add cache-hit, error, empty, boundary and page-order tests.

findings.issue: New endpoint declares no rate-limit policy intent.
findings.evidence: Controller :25 [HttpGet] with no [EnableRateLimiting]; endpoint does N D365 calls (D365Heavy candidate).
findings.impact: Heavy D365 endpoint limited only by the global 120/min policy.

findings.issue: New GET api/leave/team-calendar endpoint not added to docs/API_CONTRACTS.md.
findings.impact: FE has no documented contract for the new endpoint.

findings.issue: Leftover e2e stale C3..C6 comments at end of DTO file.
